prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity restrained dark desktop personal portfolio comp, 1536 by 1024 landscape
Primary request: Design a subtle, non-marketing personal website for Colton Spurgin using one quiet reading column and useful margin notes. It must feel like a real person’s well-kept working notebook, not a branded concept.
Scene/backdrop: flat front-facing website screenshot on soft near-black
Subject: Colton is a software developer, Air Force NCO, research assistant, and UWF senior studying artificial intelligence; he graduates December 2026
Style/medium: restrained editorial web UI, normal sentence case, small graphite-like annotations, calm spacing, precise typography, almost no decoration
Composition/framing: a small top line shows Colton Spurgin at left and Work, Background, Notes, Contact at right. One readable 620-pixel column begins at one third of the viewport and contains the plain introduction: “I’m Colton Spurgin. I’m a software developer, Air Force NCO, research assistant, and senior at UWF studying artificial intelligence. I graduate in December 2026.” A second paragraph reads: “Right now I lead development on an internship project and help with university research. After graduation, I want to keep building software and pursue a master’s degree.” The body then continues directly into Selected work with four text entries, not cards. In a narrow outer margin, small notes show Dec 2026, TypeScript · Next.js, Tauri · Rust, C++, and Ansible · Proxmox. Use one warm hairline and a few registration ticks as the only signature detail. Show enough of the next section, Background, to prove a long page works.
Color palette: soft black #101112, warm off-white #e2dfd7, graphite #8c8a84, muted clay #9b765d
Materials/textures: nearly flat black paper, faint graphite notes, one warm rule; no visible paper photo texture
Text (verbatim): “Colton Spurgin”; “Work”; “Background”; “Notes”; “Contact”; “I’m Colton Spurgin. I’m a software developer, Air Force NCO, research assistant, and senior at UWF studying artificial intelligence. I graduate in December 2026.”; “Right now I lead development on an internship project and help with university research. After graduation, I want to keep building software and pursue a master’s degree.”; “Selected work”; “Bork”; “A dog-themed social app built with TypeScript and Next.js.”; “VeLLM”; “A work-in-progress Tauri client for self-hosted Ollama models.”; “Traveling Salesman benchmarks”; “A C++ framework comparing exact and heuristic approaches.”; “Home lab”; “Ansible automation for Proxmox, Docker, and Linux.”; “Background”; “GitHub”; “LinkedIn”; “Email”
Constraints: ordinary language; normal-size headings; clearly usable dark website; strong scan hierarchy; no slogan, no self-congratulatory claim, no logo, no portrait, no invented employer names, metrics, awards, testimonials, or research specifics
Avoid: marketing landing page, oversized hero type, visual metaphor, themed interface, card grid, bento grid, neon, cyberpunk, terminal UI, cockpit, glassmorphism, gradients, decorative illustrations, rounded pills, heavy texture, 3D mockup, browser chrome, watermark
